t.zh: Workshop 2 里用 OpenCV 读进来的照片，三个数按 B、G、R 存；交给 Matplotlib 按 R、G、B 显示，红蓝就对调了，蓝天变成橙色。另一个坑：照片常用 uint8 存，0 到 255，算出来超出范围会绕回去。
t.en: In Workshop 2 a photo read with OpenCV stores its three numbers as B, G, R; shown by Matplotlib as R, G, B, red and blue trade places and a blue sky turns orange. Another trap: photos are often uint8, 0 to 255, and a result out of range wraps around.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：怎样把颜色换回来？新元件<part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref>把三张<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>依次当作 R、G、B 合成彩色图。
t.en: This level asks: how are the colours put back? New part: <part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref> makes three grey images R, G and B of one colour image. (<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>)

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>的差别和<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>的坑：先换好顺序，算之前换成更宽的类型。
after.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref> difference and the <wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref> trap: swap the order before handing over, widen the type before computing.

brief.zh: 输入是用 OpenCV 读进来的照片：交出同一张照片，颜色和本来的一样。
brief.en: The input is a photo read with OpenCV: give the same photo in its true colours.

hint.zh: 先把输入原样接到输出，看第一个不同的格子里哪几个数对调了。
hint.en: First wire the input straight to the output, and see which numbers are swapped in the first differing cell.

hint.zh: 把三个位置的数分别取出来看：天空在哪一张里最亮？蓝天本该亮在哪一种颜色上？
hint.en: Take the numbers at the three positions out one by one: in which of them is the sky brightest? Which colour should a blue sky be bright in?
